<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 320" width="900" height="320" role="img" aria-label="Pemandangan alam beranimasi: matahari, burung, pohon, bunga, kelinci, ikan, dan kupu-kupu" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <title>Dunia kecil yang hidup</title>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#38bdf8"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#bae6fd"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#e0f2fe"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="glow">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fde68a" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#fde68a" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="water" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#7dd3fc"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#0ea5e9"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <clipPath id="round"><rect width="900" height="320" rx="18"/></clipPath>

    <g id="flower">
      <path d="M0 0 Q-3 -15 0 -30" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <g fill="currentColor">
        <circle cx="0" cy="-38" r="4.5"/>
        <circle cx="6" cy="-34" r="4.5"/>
        <circle cx="4" cy="-27" r="4.5"/>
        <circle cx="-4" cy="-27" r="4.5"/>
        <circle cx="-6" cy="-34" r="4.5"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="0" cy="-32" r="3.5" fill="#fbbf24"/>
    </g>
    <g id="grass">
      <path d="M0 0 Q-2 -10 -7 -17 M0 0 Q0 -12 1 -21 M0 0 Q2 -10 8 -16" stroke="#166534" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <style>
    .spin   { animation: spin 40s linear infinite; }
    .pulse  { animation: pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
    .drift  { animation: drift 70s linear infinite; }
    .fly    { animation: fly 22s linear infinite; }
    .tree   { animation: sway 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .bloom  { animation: swayf 3.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .blade  { animation: swayf 2.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .walk   { animation: walk 20s linear infinite; }
    .hop    { animation: hop 0.7s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .swim   { animation: swim 11s linear infinite; }
    .ripple { animation: ripple 5s ease-out infinite; }
    .pad    { animation: bob 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .flutter{ animation: flutter 16s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .flap   { animation: flap 0.3s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .title  { animation: rise 1.8s ease-out both; }

    @keyframes spin    { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes pulse   { 50% { transform: scale(1.15); } }
    @keyframes drift   { from { transform: translateX(-260px); } to { transform: translateX(1160px); } }
    @keyframes fly     { 0% { transform: translate(-80px, 0); } 50% { transform: translate(450px, -28px); } 100% { transform: translate(990px, 8px); } }
    @keyframes sway    { from { transform: rotate(-2.5deg); } to { transform: rotate(2.5deg); } }
    @keyframes swayf   { from { transform: rotate(-7deg); } to { transform: rotate(7deg); } }
    @keyframes hop     { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-12px); } }
    @keyframes walk {
      0%   { transform: translateX(0) scaleX(1); }
      47%  { transform: translateX(180px) scaleX(1); }
      50%  { transform: translateX(180px) scaleX(-1); }
      97%  { transform: translateX(0) scaleX(-1); }
      100% { transform: translateX(0) scaleX(1); }
    }
    @keyframes swim {
      0%   { transform: translateX(-60px) scaleX(1); }
      47%  { transform: translateX(60px) scaleX(1); }
      50%  { transform: translateX(60px) scaleX(-1); }
      97%  { transform: translateX(-60px) scaleX(-1); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-60px) scaleX(1); }
    }
    @keyframes ripple  { 0% { transform: scale(0.15); opacity: 0.9; } 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0; } }
    @keyframes bob     { from { transform: translateY(0); } to { transform: translateY(2px); } }
    @keyframes flutter {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(90px, -35px); }
      50% { transform: translate(170px, 8px); }
      75% { transform: translate(80px, 42px); }
    }
    @keyframes flap    { from { transform: scaleX(1); } to { transform: scaleX(0.2); } }
    @keyframes rise    { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { * { animation: none !important; } }
  </style>

  <g clip-path="url(#round)">
    <!-- Langit -->
    <rect width="900" height="320" fill="url(#sky)"/>

    <!-- Matahari -->
    <g transform="translate(790,72)">
      <circle r="80" fill="url(#glow)" class="pulse"/>
      <g class="spin">
        <circle r="50" fill="none" stroke="#fbbf24" stroke-width="16" stroke-dasharray="6 20.18" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>
      <circle r="34" fill="#fcd34d"/>
      <circle r="27" fill="#fde047"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Awan -->
    <g class="drift" style="animation-duration:75s; animation-delay:-30s">
      <g transform="translate(0,62)" fill="#fff" opacity="0.95">
        <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="42" ry="14"/><ellipse cx="-18" cy="-10" rx="22" ry="15"/><ellipse cx="14" cy="-14" rx="26" ry="18"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g class="drift" style="animation-duration:100s; animation-delay:-70s">
      <g transform="translate(0,120)" fill="#fff" opacity="0.85">
        <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="34" ry="11"/><ellipse cx="-12" cy="-8" rx="18" ry="12"/><ellipse cx="12" cy="-10" rx="20" ry="14"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g class="drift" style="animation-duration:90s; animation-delay:-5s">
      <g transform="translate(0,28)" fill="#fff" opacity="0.8">
        <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="28" ry="9"/><ellipse cx="-8" cy="-7" rx="15" ry="10"/><ellipse cx="10" cy="-8" rx="16" ry="11"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Burung -->
    <g class="fly" style="animation-duration:22s; animation-delay:-4s">
      <g transform="translate(0,85) scale(1.3)">
        <path d="M-10 0 Q-5 -9 0 0 Q5 -9 10 0" fill="none" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animate attributeName="d" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"
            values="M-10 0 Q-5 -9 0 0 Q5 -9 10 0;M-10 5 Q-5 1 0 0 Q5 1 10 5;M-10 0 Q-5 -9 0 0 Q5 -9 10 0"/>
        </path>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g class="fly" style="animation-duration:28s; animation-delay:-14s">
      <g transform="translate(0,55)">
        <path d="M-10 0 Q-5 -9 0 0 Q5 -9 10 0" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animate attributeName="d" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"
            values="M-10 0 Q-5 -9 0 0 Q5 -9 10 0;M-10 5 Q-5 1 0 0 Q5 1 10 5;M-10 0 Q-5 -9 0 0 Q5 -9 10 0"/>
        </path>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g class="fly" style="animation-duration:34s; animation-delay:-22s">
      <g transform="translate(0,110) scale(0.8)">
        <path d="M-10 0 Q-5 -9 0 0 Q5 -9 10 0" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animate attributeName="d" dur="0.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"
            values="M-10 0 Q-5 -9 0 0 Q5 -9 10 0;M-10 5 Q-5 1 0 0 Q5 1 10 5;M-10 0 Q-5 -9 0 0 Q5 -9 10 0"/>
        </path>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Bukit -->
    <path d="M0 215 Q120 150 260 205 T520 190 T780 200 T900 180 V320 H0Z" fill="#86efac"/>
    <path d="M0 245 Q180 195 360 240 T720 235 T900 225 V320 H0Z" fill="#4ade80"/>
    <path d="M0 268 Q225 252 450 266 T900 262 V320 H0Z" fill="#22c55e"/>

    <!-- Pohon -->
    <g transform="translate(120,264) scale(1.15)">
      <g class="tree">
        <rect x="-6" y="-55" width="12" height="55" rx="3" fill="#92400e"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="-80" r="30" fill="#15803d"/>
        <circle cx="-24" cy="-62" r="22" fill="#166534"/>
        <circle cx="24" cy="-62" r="22" fill="#166534"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="-94" r="20" fill="#16a34a"/>
        <circle cx="-10" cy="-72" r="3.2" fill="#ef4444"/><circle cx="12" cy="-88" r="3.2" fill="#ef4444"/><circle cx="22" cy="-62" r="3.2" fill="#ef4444"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(255,260)">
      <g class="tree" style="animation-delay:-2s; animation-duration:7s">
        <rect x="-4" y="-28" width="8" height="28" fill="#78350f"/>
        <polygon points="0,-62 -32,-22 32,-22" fill="#166534"/>
        <polygon points="0,-82 -26,-42 26,-42" fill="#15803d"/>
        <polygon points="0,-104 -20,-64 20,-64" fill="#16a34a"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(640,260)">
      <g class="tree" style="animation-delay:-3s; animation-duration:5.5s">
        <rect x="-4" y="-28" width="8" height="28" fill="#78350f"/>
        <polygon points="0,-62 -32,-22 32,-22" fill="#166534"/>
        <polygon points="0,-82 -26,-42 26,-42" fill="#15803d"/>
        <polygon points="0,-104 -20,-64 20,-64" fill="#16a34a"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(790,266) scale(1.25)">
      <g class="tree" style="animation-delay:-1s; animation-duration:6.5s">
        <rect x="-6" y="-55" width="12" height="55" rx="3" fill="#92400e"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="-80" r="30" fill="#15803d"/>
        <circle cx="-24" cy="-62" r="22" fill="#166534"/>
        <circle cx="24" cy="-62" r="22" fill="#166534"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="-94" r="20" fill="#16a34a"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Kolam -->
    <ellipse cx="450" cy="290" rx="105" ry="20" fill="#16a34a"/>
    <ellipse cx="450" cy="289" rx="98" ry="17" fill="url(#water)"/>
    <g transform="translate(450,289)">
      <ellipse class="ripple" rx="70" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse class="ripple" rx="70" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8" style="animation-delay:-2.5s"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Ikan -->
    <g transform="translate(450,287)">
      <g class="swim">
        <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="8" ry="3.8" fill="#fb923c"/>
        <polygon points="-7,0 -14,-4.5 -14,4.5" fill="#f97316"/>
        <circle cx="4" cy="-1" r="1" fill="#1f2937"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(450,295)">
      <g class="swim" style="animation-delay:-6s; animation-duration:14s">
        <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#fde68a"/>
        <polygon points="-5,0 -11,-3.5 -11,3.5" fill="#facc15"/>
        <circle cx="3" cy="-0.8" r="0.9" fill="#1f2937"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <!-- Teratai -->
    <g transform="translate(405,292)">
      <g class="pad">
        <ellipse rx="10" ry="3.6" fill="#15803d"/>
        <circle cy="-3" r="3" fill="#f9a8d4"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Rumput & bunga -->
    <g transform="translate(40,300)"><use href="#grass" class="blade"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(70,306)"><use href="#flower" class="bloom" style="color:#f472b6"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(160,304)"><use href="#flower" class="bloom" style="color:#fb7185; animation-delay:-1s"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(200,300)"><use href="#grass" class="blade" style="animation-delay:-1.4s"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(300,306)"><use href="#flower" class="bloom" style="color:#fde047; animation-delay:-2s"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(340,302)"><use href="#grass" class="blade"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(560,302)"><use href="#grass" class="blade" style="animation-delay:-2s"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(600,306)"><use href="#flower" class="bloom" style="color:#c084fc; animation-delay:-0.5s"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(680,304)"><use href="#flower" class="bloom" style="color:#f472b6; animation-delay:-1.5s"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(730,300)"><use href="#grass" class="blade" style="animation-delay:-0.8s"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(770,306)"><use href="#flower" class="bloom" style="color:#fb923c; animation-delay:-2.4s"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(850,304)"><use href="#flower" class="bloom" style="color:#fde047; animation-delay:-1.2s"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(880,300)"><use href="#grass" class="blade"/></g>

    <!-- Kelinci -->
    <g transform="translate(565,300)">
      <g class="walk">
        <g class="hop">
          <ellipse cx="-14" cy="-10" rx="4.5" ry="4.5" fill="#fff"/>
          <ellipse cx="0" cy="-10" rx="14" ry="9" fill="#f5f5f4" stroke="#d6d3d1" stroke-width="0.8"/>
          <ellipse cx="-6" cy="-1.5" rx="5.5" ry="2.5" fill="#e7e5e4"/>
          <ellipse cx="9" cy="-1.5" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#e7e5e4"/>
          <ellipse cx="9" cy="-30" rx="2.8" ry="8" fill="#f5f5f4" stroke="#d6d3d1" stroke-width="0.8" transform="rotate(-10 9 -30)"/>
          <ellipse cx="15" cy="-29" rx="2.8" ry="8" fill="#f5f5f4" stroke="#d6d3d1" stroke-width="0.8" transform="rotate(12 15 -29)"/>
          <ellipse cx="9" cy="-30" rx="1.2" ry="5" fill="#fbcfe8" transform="rotate(-10 9 -30)"/>
          <circle cx="12" cy="-17" r="7" fill="#f5f5f4" stroke="#d6d3d1" stroke-width="0.8"/>
          <circle cx="15" cy="-18" r="1.4" fill="#1f2937"/>
          <circle cx="19" cy="-16" r="1" fill="#f472b6"/>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Kupu-kupu -->
    <g transform="translate(330,190)">
      <g class="flutter">
        <g class="flap">
          <ellipse cx="-6" cy="-3" rx="6" ry="8" fill="#f472b6" transform="rotate(-20 -6 -3)"/>
          <ellipse cx="6" cy="-3" rx="6" ry="8" fill="#f9a8d4" transform="rotate(20 6 -3)"/>
          <ellipse cx="-4" cy="5" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#ec4899"/>
          <ellipse cx="4" cy="5" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#f472b6"/>
        </g>
        <rect x="-1" y="-8" width="2" height="18" rx="1" fill="#3f3f46"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Teks -->
    <g class="title">
      <text x="40" y="70" font-family="'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#0c4a6e">Hi, I'm Jibril</text>
      <text x="42" y="98" font-family="'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#075985">Menanam ide, tumbuh jadi kode.</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
